description: Compose a transaction to create, open, or close a dispenser. Dispensers automatically sell tokens for BTC.

escrow_quantity.description: Raw integer total amount to load into dispenser. For divisible: human amount * 10^8. Use 0 when closing.

give_quantity.description: Raw integer amount of asset per dispense. For divisible: human amount * 10^8. Use 0 when closing.

inputs_set.description: Comma-separated UTXOs to use as inputs (txid:vout)

mainchainrate.description: BTC price per dispense (in satoshis). Use 0 when closing.

open_address.description: Open dispenser on a different address

sat_per_vbyte.description: Fee rate in satoshis per virtual byte (e.g. 1, 5.5, 0.15). Check get_fee_estimate for current market rates.

name: compose_dispenser
